title: Add company logo to navigation bar and footer

requirements.text: Add the uploaded True Origin Exports logo (to be saved as frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.png) to the navigation bar. Display it on the left side of the nav, replacing or accompanying the current text-based brand name. The logo should be appropriately sized for a navigation bar (height ~40–48px) and must be visible against the nav background on both scroll states (transparent and solid).

quotes: Add the logo to the website

acceptanceCriteria: The True Origin Exports logo image is displayed in the navigation bar on the left side
The logo is sized appropriately for the nav bar (approx. 40–48px tall)
The logo is visible in both the transparent (top of page) and solid (scrolled) nav states
The logo also appears in the site footer alongside the brand information
Clicking the logo scrolls back to the top / home section

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui
Logo image must be served as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated/
nonGoals: Redesigning the navigation bar layout beyond adding the logo
Changing the existing color theme or typography

edits: Crop to remove the white background, keeping only the globe-and-leaf emblem with 'TrueOrigin EXPORTS' text on a transparent background (IMG_5015.jpeg > logo.dim_400x300.png)
